audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl (E) appears nowhere on the page, and the text never names Jaws of the Beast, Blood Hunt or Eternal Hunger — it refers to 'his Q drain', 'W move speed', 'his passive'.
audit.why: Primal Howl gives Warwick damage reduction for 2.5 seconds and then fears everything nearby for 1 second on a 15s-at-rank-1 cooldown. A Lucian combo dumped into it is halved and then interrupted — that is the single most punishable mistake in the matchup and it was entirely absent.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2] now names Primal Howl and its 2.5s window; the content prose now uses the real ability names.
sources: brief enemyKit E text and cd 15/14/13/12/11
packet defects (never names any of Warwick's abilities)

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] told you to 'dash the instant his R suppress lands'.
audit.why: Infinite Duress is a suppression — it disables Relentless Pursuit for its full 1.5 seconds. The dash can only come out the moment it ends. mid already stated this correctly, so the page contradicted itself.
audit.corrected: wants.you[2] now reads 'the instant the 1.5s suppress ends'.
sources: brief enemyKit R text (suppressing the first champion for 1.5 seconds)

audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row is marked Lucian at 8/10 in both layers while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say Warwick takes over once lifesteal comes online. whys[4] also renders with a stray 'Skill:' prefix on a row that says Lucian.
audit.why: Eternal Hunger heals him for his bonus magic damage below 50% health and triples it below 25%, and Jaws of the Beast scales on the target's maximum health — a two-item Warwick out-sustains a marksman with no bruiser stats.
audit.corrected: 2+ items flipped to Warwick in both layers at 3/10; whys[4] prefix removed and the line rebuilt on Infinite Duress.
sources: brief enemyKit P and Q text

audit.why: Spikes are right: Lucian owns levels 2-3 and the first item, Warwick's only real lane spike is Infinite Duress at 6 (110/90/70s), and his takeover is item-driven rather than level-driven.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal is a trailing clause on the itemization line with no timing, and nothing warns that Jaws of the Beast deals maximum-health damage.
audit.why: Three separate sources of healing (Eternal Hunger, Jaws of the Beast, Infinite Duress) mean Grievous Wounds timing decides every extended trade, and percent-max-health damage means stacking armour alone misreads the all-in.
audit.corrected: late now names the Grievous Wounds buy timing.
sources: brief enemyKit heal flags on P/Q/R, percentHealth flag on Q

edits.before: Warwick whiffs Infinite Duress and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Primal Howl cuts your damage 2.5s then fears — poke after it, not into it.

edits.before: Skill: his R suppress chains his full drain and can kill your low HP, but you survive it cleanly if you save E for the unlock.
edits.after: Infinite Duress chains his whole drain combo and can kill you outright, but a saved Relentless Pursuit gets you out the moment it ends.

edits.before: His R suppress-locks you in place and chains his full drain — if he hits it without your E ready, you die; keep Relentless Pursuit for the unlock.
edits.after: Infinite Duress suppresses you for 1.5s and chains his full drain — without Relentless Pursuit saved for the instant it ends, you simply die.

edits.before: Hold Relentless Pursuit (E) to dash the instant his R suppress lands, or all-in only when his R is down
edits.after: Hold Relentless Pursuit (E) to dash the instant the 1.5s suppress ends, and all-in only when R is down

edits.before: Land R suppress to lock you in place and channel his full drain combo through your low HP
edits.after: Land Infinite Duress to suppress you 1.5s and channel his full drain through your low HP

edits.before: Chase you down with W move speed and stick through your kite to force a sustain fight
edits.after: Chase with Blood Hunt's move speed once you're under 50% and force a sustain fight

edits.before: Warwick is one of the worst level-1s in the game and has no answer to your auto range — last-hit at the tip of Q and chunk him whenever he steps up for a minion. Your level 2 is the kill window: Q into the Lightslinger double-shot hits harder than his Q drain can heal back, so trade every time his W move-speed is on cooldown. At 3 you mark him with W, damage the mark for the burst of speed, and weave E to slip his chase — he simply cannot stick to you yet.
edits.after: Warwick is one of the worst level-1s in the game and has no answer to your auto range — last-hit at the tip of Q and chunk him whenever he steps up for a minion. Your level 2 is the kill window: Q into the Lightslinger double-shot hits harder than Jaws of the Beast heals back, and that lunge is his only gap-closer, on an 8s cooldown at rank 1. At 3 you mark him with W, damage the mark for the speed, and weave E to slip his chase entirely.

edits.before: You stay ahead through 4-5: keep poking with Q and using the W-mark move speed to control spacing so he never gets a free drain reset off your HP bar. Level 6 is the one stage you respect — his R suppress-locks you and channels his whole combo, and your base HP is low enough to die through it. The rule is simple: never all-in when his R is up, and hold Relentless Pursuit (E) so you can dash the moment the suppress ends to break his W chase.
edits.after: You stay ahead through 4-5: poke with Q and use the W-mark move speed to control spacing so he never gets a free drain reset off your HP bar. Watch Primal Howl — 2.5s of damage reduction that ends in a fear, so a combo dumped into it is wasted twice. Level 6 is the stage you respect: Infinite Duress suppresses 1.5s and channels his whole combo through your low base HP. Hold Relentless Pursuit for the instant it ends.

edits.before: This is where it flips. Warwick's passive heals harder the lower you are, and once he has lifesteal and bruiser items his sustained DPS out-stats your squishy ADC frame — a drawn-out fight feeds his healing. You are a weak scaler for the role, so you must have converted your levels 2-6 dominance into a lead and a tempo advantage. If the game goes long even, kite him with W speed in skirmishes, never get caught alone for his R, and let your frontline soak the suppress.
edits.after: This is where it flips. Eternal Hunger heals him for his bonus damage below 50% health and triples that below 25%, so a drawn-out fight feeds him — buy Grievous Wounds before your second item or he simply out-heals you. You are a weak scaler for the role, so your levels 2-6 dominance has to already be a lead. If the game goes long even, kite with W speed in skirmishes, never get caught alone, and let your frontline soak Infinite Duress.

notes: Two things I could not verify from the kit data and therefore did not write: whether Infinite Duress's suppression is removed by QSS/Cleanse in the current patch, and whether Primal Howl's damage reduction applies to Lucian's Lightslinger double-shot as one instance or two. The page now avoids claiming either. Warwick's W range reads 4000 in the kit file, which is the sense/hunt range, not a chase range — I did not put that number on the page.
